attackers_goals: Deleting an ingress rule may allow an attacker to gain persistence in the cloud environment. Deleting an egress rule may enable data exfiltration.
description: An AWS network ACL rule was created with a specific rule number.
investigative_actions: Check the VPC affected by this change. Verify the rule number (as rules are applied in order). Determine whether the rule is ingress or egress.
name: AWS network ACL rule creation
